segments.an4.163:1.3: Dukkhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā, dukkhā paṭipadā khippābhiññā, sukhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā, sukhā paṭipadā khippābhiññā.
segments.an4.163:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu asubhānupassī kāye viharati, āhāre paṭikūlasaññī [paṭikkūlasaññī (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)], sabbaloke anabhiratisaññī [anabhiratasaññī (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)], sabbasaṅkhāresu aniccānupassī;
segments.an4.163:2.3: maraṇasaññā kho panassa ajjhattaṃ sūpaṭṭhitā hoti.
segments.an4.163:2.4: So imāni pañca sekhabalāni [sekkhabalāni (syā. kaṃ.)] upanissāya viharati – saddhābalaṃ, hiribalaṃ, ottappabalaṃ, vīriyabalaṃ, paññābalaṃ.
segments.an4.163:2.6: Tassimāni pañcindriyāni mudūni pātubhavanti – saddhindriyaṃ, vīriyindriyaṃ, satindriyaṃ, samādhindriyaṃ, paññindriyaṃ.
segments.an4.163:2.8: So imesaṃ pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ muduttā dandhaṃ ānantariyaṃ pāpuṇāti āsavānaṃ khayāya.
segments.an4.163:2.9: Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, dukkhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā.
segments.an4.163:3.2: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu asubhānupassī kāye viharati, āhāre paṭikūlasaññī, sabbaloke anabhiratisaññī, sabbasaṅkhāresu aniccānupassī;
segments.an4.163:3.3: maraṇasaññā kho panassa ajjhattaṃ sūpaṭṭhitā hoti.
segments.an4.163:3.4: So imāni pañca sekhabalāni upanissāya viharati – saddhābalaṃ … pe … paññābalaṃ.
segments.an4.163:3.6: Tassimāni pañcindriyāni adhimattāni pātubhavanti – saddhindriyaṃ … pe … paññindriyaṃ.
segments.an4.163:3.8: So imesaṃ pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ adhimattattā khippaṃ ānantariyaṃ pāpuṇāti āsavānaṃ khayāya.
segments.an4.163:3.9: Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, dukkhā paṭipadā khippābhiññā.
segments.an4.163:4.2: Idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati;
segments.an4.163:4.3: vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati;
segments.an4.163:4.4: pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharati sato ca sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti yaṃ taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti – ‘upekkhako satimā sukhavihārī’ti tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati;
segments.an4.163:4.5: sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.an4.163:4.6: So imāni pañca sekhabalāni upanissāya viharati – saddhābalaṃ … pe … paññābalaṃ.
segments.an4.163:4.8: Tassimāni pañcindriyāni mudūni pātubhavanti – saddhindriyaṃ … pe … paññindriyaṃ.
segments.an4.163:4.10: So imesaṃ pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ muduttā dandhaṃ ānantariyaṃ pāpuṇāti āsavānaṃ khayāya.
segments.an4.163:4.11: Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, sukhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā.
segments.an4.163:5.1: “Katamā ca, bhikkhave, sukhā paṭipadā khippābhiññā?[kathā.815 ādayo] Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati … pe … dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ … pe … tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ … pe … catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
segments.an4.163:5.3: So imāni pañca sekhabalāni upanissāya viharati – saddhābalaṃ, hiribalaṃ, ottappabalaṃ, vīriyabalaṃ, paññābalaṃ.
segments.an4.163:5.5: Tassimāni pañcindriyāni adhimattāni pātubhavanti – saddhindriyaṃ, vīriyindriyaṃ, satindriyaṃ, samādhindriyaṃ, paññindriyaṃ.
segments.an4.163:5.7: So imesaṃ pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ adhimattattā khippaṃ ānantariyaṃ pāpuṇāti āsavānaṃ khayāya.
segments.an4.163:5.8: Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, sukhā paṭipadā khippābhiññā.

lines: Tatiye asubhānupassī kāye viharatīti attano karajakāye “yathā etaṃ, tathā idan”ti iminā nayena bahiddhā diṭṭhānaṃ dasannaṃ asubhānaṃ upasaṃharaṇavasena asubhānupassī viharati, attano kāyaṃ asubhato paṭikūlato ñāṇena passatīti attho.
Āhāre paṭikūlasaññīti navannaṃ pāṭikulyānaṃ vasena kabaḷīkārāhāre paṭikūlasaññī.
Sabbaloke anabhiratisaññīti sabbasmimpi tedhātuke lokasannivāse anabhiratāya ukkaṇṭhitasaññāya samannāgato.
Ajjhattaṃ sūpaṭṭhitā hotīti niyakajjhatte suṭṭhu upaṭṭhitā hoti.
“Asubhānupassī”tiādīni pana dukkhāya paṭipadāya dassanatthaṃ vuttāni, paṭhamajjhānādīni sukhāya.
Asubhādīni hi paṭikūlārammaṇāni, tesu pana pakatiyāva sampiyāyamānaṃ cittaṃ allīyati.
Tasmā tāni bhāvento dukkhapaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno nāma hoti.
Paṭhamajjhānādīni paṇītasukhāni, tasmā tāni paṭipanno sukhapaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno nāma hoti.
